parts:
You can attach Joshua's acceptance letter and send something like this:

:::writing{variant="email" id="67184" subject="Scholarship Award for Joshua [Last Name]"}
Dear Financial Aid Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I recently spoke with a member of your Financial Aid Department regarding a scholarship award for Joshua [Last Name], an incoming student at Lipscomb University. Per our conversation, I am attaching documentation confirming Joshua's acceptance of a $2,500 scholarship awarded through Alignment Nashville.

We would like to coordinate the payment of these scholarship funds directly to Joshua's student account. Please let us know the appropriate process and provide any instructions, forms, or direct deposit information needed for us to remit the funds.

If there is any additional documentation required from our organization or from Joshua, please let us know and we will be happy to provide it promptly.

Thank you for your assistance. We appreciate your help in ensuring these scholarship funds are properly applied to support Joshua's education at Lipscomb.

Warm regards,

Bethany Gifford  
Alignment Nashville  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]

Attachment: Scholarship Acceptance Letter
:::

If you know Joshua's student ID number, include it in the email as well—it will help the Financial Aid office locate his account much faster.

Here's a polished email you can send to Heather:

:::writing{variant="email" id="58421" subject="Lipscomb Scholarship Funding Process"}
Hi Heather,

I wanted to give you a quick update regarding Joshua's scholarship funds.

I was able to get in touch with the Financial Aid Department at Lipscomb and spoke with a representative who explained the process for applying the scholarship to Joshua's account. He recommended that we send an email to financialaid@lipscomb.edu along with documentation showing Joshua's acceptance of the $2,500 scholarship award.

Once they receive that information, their team will contact us with instructions for submitting the funds via direct deposit so the scholarship can be applied appropriately to his student account.

Additionally, he mentioned that he plans to reach out to Joshua regarding a program called Backpack Pay, which may provide opportunities for him to apply for additional scholarships if he's interested.

Would you like me to go ahead and send the email to Financial Aid and coordinate the next steps, or would you prefer to take it from here? I'm happy to help either way.

Thank you!

Bethany
:::

This version keeps it professional, informative, and gives Heather a clear next step.
